# vpsie_control_collectors (Data Source)

Lists the collectors (the agents that read and operate platforms outside VPSie) of the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vpsie_control_collectors" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether Control is on for the account. When it is not, the list is empty and `reason` says why.
- `collectors` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collectors))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `reason` (String) Why Control is not available: `notLicensed`, `disabledByOperator` or `disabledForTenant`.

<a id="nestedatt--collectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collectors`

Read-Only:

- `agent_version` (String) The collector agent version, once it has reported.
- `identifier` (String) The collector identifier.
- `last_seen_at` (String) When the collector last reported (RFC 3339).
- `mode` (String) How it reaches the platforms: `helper`, `vpn` or `zt`.
- `name` (String) The collector name.
- `platform_count` (Number) Platforms assigned to the collector.
- `purpose` (String) `control` or `migrate`, when the platform reports it.
- `state` (String) `pending`, `enrolled` or `revoked`.
